name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-04-16, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
